name: pilot-deployment-adapter
purpose: Define a replaceable provider-neutral interface invoked only after explicit release approval.

rules.provider_neutral_core: Core orchestration must consume this adapter contract rather than provider-specific deployment fields.
rules.no_development_invocation: Routine build and development verification must not invoke this adapter.
rules.approved_only: Deploy may be invoked only for APPROVED_FOR_RELEASE work.
rules.failure_preserves_state: Blocked, failed, or degraded provider results must preserve release state and evidence for safe retry or recovery.
